gloss: snow pea; sugar snap pea; pod pea

definitions.gloss: snow pea; sugar snap pea; pod pea
definitions.explanation: an edible-podded pea eaten whole while still young and flat, commonly used in Japanese cooking

examples.japanese: さやえんどうの{筋|すじ}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: Remove the strings from the snow peas.

examples.japanese: さやえんどうをさっと{茹|ゆ}でて{彩|いろど}りにする。
examples.english: Quickly blanch the snow peas and use them as a garnish.

examples.japanese: {煮物|にもの}の{仕上|しあ}げにさやえんどうを{添|そ}えると{見栄|みば}えがよくなる。
examples.english: Adding snow peas as a finishing touch to simmered dishes improves the presentation.

notes:
A vegetable commonly used in Japanese home cooking. Often blanched briefly and used as a green garnish on dishes like {煮物|にもの} (simmered dishes), {丼|どんぶり} (rice bowls), and {親子丼|おやこどん}. Also stir-fried or used in soups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- さやえんどうの{筋|すじ}を{取|と}る: to string snow peas
- さやえんどうを{茹|ゆ}でる: to boil snow peas
- さやえんどうの{卵|たまご}とじ: snow peas with egg

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. Can also be written {莢豌豆|さやえんどう} in kanji, but this is rare. Sometimes written as サヤエンドウ in katakana in scientific or agricultural contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- {絹|きぬ}さや: another name for snow peas, often used interchangeably
- {枝豆|えだまめ}: edamame (green soybeans)
- スナップえんどう: sugar snap peas (thicker variety)
